LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_A.source: 我这次期末考都没念书。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_A.zh_CN: 我这次期末考都没念书。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_A.en: I didn't even study for these finals.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_B.en: The results came out: full marks again.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_RELATION.source: 嘴上淡化努力，话里展示成绩。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_RELATION.zh_CN: 嘴上淡化努力，话里展示成绩。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_RELATION.en: Downplays the effort while showing off the result.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_ANCHOR.source: 保留淡化努力与展示成绩之间的反差，用文字完成自述。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_ANCHOR.zh_CN: 保留淡化努力与展示成绩之间的反差，用文字完成自述。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_ANCHOR.en: Keep the contrast between playing down the effort and showing off the result in a written account.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_HINT.source: 把成绩说成轻松得来，等别人听出炫耀。期末考试是游戏编写的文字例子。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_HINT.zh_CN: 把成绩说成轻松得来，等别人听出炫耀。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_VERSAILLES_HINT.en: Makes success sound effortless and leaves others to notice the brag.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_B.source: 我：让我再讲一遍这部剧哪里好看。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_B.zh_CN: 我：让我再讲一遍这部剧哪里好看。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_B.en: Me: let me explain once more why this show is so good.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_RELATION.source: 没人提问，自己先忍不住开口。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_RELATION.zh_CN: 没人提问，自己先忍不住开口。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_RELATION.en: No one asks, but the speaker cannot resist starting.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_ANCHOR.source: 保留无人发问的空白与主动发言之间的反差。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_ANCHOR.zh_CN: 保留无人发问的空白与主动发言之间的反差。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_ANCHOR.en: Keep the contrast between an unprompted silence and someone speaking up.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_HINT.source: 先留一句无人发问的空白，再写谁忍不住说了什么。剧集话题是游戏改编。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_HINT.zh_CN: 先留一句无人发问的空白，再写谁忍不住说了什么。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_NOBODY_HINT.en: Leave the opening silent, then show who speaks without being asked.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_BOOMER_SITUATION.source: 又听到“你们这一代就是不肯努力”。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_BOOMER_SITUATION.zh_CN: 又听到“你们这一代就是不肯努力”。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_BOOMER_SITUATION.en: Hears another claim that this generation simply refuses to work hard.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_BOOMER_ANCHOR.source: 保留对代际说教的简短回应，以及拒绝继续争辩的姿态。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_BOOMER_ANCHOR.zh_CN: 保留对代际说教的简短回应，以及拒绝继续争辩的姿态。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_BOOMER_ANCHOR.en: Keep the short reply to a generational lecture and the refusal to keep arguing.

LOC_TEXT_STARTER_BOOMER_HINT.source: 用一句短回复打断代际说教。学校里的对话是游戏编写的情境。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_BOOMER_HINT.zh_CN: 用一句短回复打断代际说教。
LOC_TEXT_STARTER_BOOMER_HINT.en: Cuts off a generational lecture with a short reply.
